messages:
maya: quick design review — posting the pathmap IA proposal here. main goal: reduce top-level items from 9 -> 6, group Model Catalog + Versions under Models, and put Deployments + Capacity into a single Ops bucket. thoughts?

sam: love shrinking noise. will this change deep links? existing app links are used in docs and customers.

ellie: yes good call. main risk is breaking bookmarked routes. we should preserve canonical /models/:id and add redirects. also breadcrumb behavior needs to reflect grouping without losing original path.

raj: redirect plan sounds fine. prefer a router-level alias rather than server redirects. react-router can map newPath -> oldPath while keeping URL stable. can we have examples?

maya: example routes proposed: `/#/models`, `/#/models/:id`, `/#/ops/deployments`, `/#/ops/capacity`. for backwards compatibility accept `/#/deployments` and `/#/capacity` and 301/alias to new paths.

alex: quick nit: if we keep hash routing we can do aliases client-side via `history.replace` on mount. but for SEO/docs we should keep canonical links in the console footer.

lenny: accessibility nit — when we collapse items into Ops, ensure screen reader announces the expanded state and breadcrumbs include the full hierarchy, e.g., "Console > Ops > Deployments". also preserve aria-current on the active item.

ellie: agree. also copy tweak: change sidebar label from "Capacity" -> "Dedicated" for clarity? customers confuse capacity with quotas.

sam: +1 on copy tweak but we should audit all mentions in docs and onboarding flows. will product own that?

maya: product will coordinate doc updates. rollout plan: feature flag the new sidebar for 10% of internal users, gather telemetry on click-throughs and deep-link hits.

ui-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy.preview/redwood/console/1712349998 — includes dev routing map and alias rules.

raj: testing checklist: 1) bookmarked legacy routes redirect correctly, 2) breadcrumbs show both canonical and visual group, 3) deep links from share links open target state, 4) keyboard nav across regrouped items preserves focus order.

ellie: one more UX question — breadcrumbs: should they reflect logical grouping or actual path? e.g., for a deployment page under old `/deployments/:id`, do we show Console > Ops > Deployments OR Console > Deployments?

maya: decision: show logical grouping (Console > Ops > Deployments) but include a small subtitle with the legacy path for power users. maybe collapsed by default. open to ideas.

alex: implementation note: keep route-to-breadcrumb mapping in a single source of truth file `routes.ts` so both router and breadcrumb component import it. prevents drift.

lenny: accessibility review req: once feature flagged, run axe snapshot on both legacy and new IA states and log diffs.

sam: timing? can we aim for a canary next week and wider rollout in two sprints if metrics look good?

maya: yes — I'll create the PR with the route aliases and small copy changes today. tagging @raj for router review and @lenny for a11y signoff. :thumbsup:

raj: got it, will review this afternoon.

ellie: will update the design spec and add the subtitle mock for power users.

maya: thanks all — keeping this thread for async followups.
